title: DriftReport
description: The output of verifier-core.ts. Consumed by the template renderer (drift-report.md.sh) in the no-LLM path, and by future consumers (Slack notifiers, CI annotations, etc.).

range.description: The git range the verifier analyzed.

from.description: The starting commit hash. Empty string means the range starts at the root of the repo (no DONE.md commit found).

to.description: The ending commit hash (always 'HEAD' for the current run).

total.description: The number of commits analyzed in the range.

items.description: The drift items detected. Empty array means the session is clean.

hash.description: The 40-char commit hash. Present for items tied to a specific commit.

taskId.description: The 3-digit task ID (e.g., T-001). Present when the category is tied to a task.

subject.description: The commit subject line. Single-line, no embedded newlines (sanitized by the algorithm).

action.description: A 1-line action recommendation for the user.

note.description: Optional context (e.g., for stale-archive items, explains that the hash is no longer reachable).

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings emitted by the algorithm. Examples: 'DONE.md missing; discipline archive not in use', 'TASKS.md missing; discipline archive not in use', 'no commits analyzed'.
